integrity: The stated infinite-family formula is proved analytically; symbolic and sampled numerical checks provide reproducibility only. Literature overlap searches are non-exhaustive.
limitations: Four-state n=3 predecessor explicitly published in 2004, not claimed as new.
SLEM is an asymptotic spectral quantity, not an exact finite-time mixing measure.
No nonreversible kernels, unequal stationary masses, or longer pendant paths are classified.
Independent external mathematical validation has not been performed.
An earlier 2003 technical report is listed with month-only dating; the 2004-10-29 public release is day-verified and does not assert that no earlier access existed.
scope: All symmetric nonnegative stochastic kernels on a clique of n>=4 vertices with one additional pendant leaf, including non-invariant internal clique weights.
title: Fastest mixing on a clique with one pendant vertex: a complete optimizer face
